q: In which case does a driver make a forced stop?
Stopping immediately before a pedestrian crossing to give way to a pedestrian
Stopping on the carriageway because of a technical fault of the vehicle
In both of the listed cases

«Forced stop» is the halting of a vehicle due to its technical fault, a danger created by the cargo being carried, the condition of the driver (passenger) or the appearance of an obstacle on the road. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Forced stop»)
Are you allowed to turn onto the unpaved road?
Allowed
Allowed only if the vehicle has a technical fault
Prohibited

Ahead in your direction of travel there is warning sign 1.11.2 «Dangerous bend» and signs 1.34.2 «Direction of turn», which show the direction of movement on a small-radius bend with limited visibility. Nothing prohibits you from turning onto the unpaved road. You may turn right if you wish. (Road signs)
May you stop at the indicated place to pick up a passenger?
You may
You may if you are driving a taxi
You may not
Sign 3.28 «No parking» does not prohibit stopping. You may stop at the indicated place. (Road signs)
Which of these signs prohibit moped riders from entering?
Only A
Only B
C and D
All of them

All the listed signs prohibit moped riders: A – 4.4.1 «Cycle path»; B – 5.14.1 «Lane for route vehicles»; C – 4.5.2 «Shared pedestrian and cycle path»; D – 4.5.4 «Pedestrian and cycle path with separated traffic». (Road signs) Only sign 5.14.2 «Cycle lane» permits mopeds, but it is not shown in the question. ПДД clause 24.7
You intend to turn left. Where should you stop to give way to the passenger car?
Before the sign
Before the intersection at the marking line
In the intersection before the broken marking line
Anywhere at the driver's discretion

According to sign 2.4 «Give way», drivers must give way to vehicles travelling on the intersecting road. Marking 1.13, in the form of triangles, shows where to stop if necessary. You do need to stop, because when turning left you give way to the passenger car. (Road signs, Horizontal road markings)
What does a flashing green traffic light mean?
It warns that the traffic light is faulty
It permits movement and informs that a prohibiting signal will soon be switched on
It prohibits further movement

A flashing green signal usually lasts 3–4 seconds. This lets the driver decide in advance, depending on the conditions: 1) continue at the same speed; 2) increase speed slightly; 3) start slowing down, up to stopping. (ПДД clause 6.2)
The driver must give signals with the direction indicators (or by hand):
Before moving off or changing lanes
Before turning or making a U-turn
Before stopping
In all of the listed cases

Before moving off, changing lanes, turning (making a U-turn) and stopping, the driver must signal with the direction indicators for the corresponding direction, or by hand if they are absent or faulty. A manoeuvre must not create a danger to traffic or obstruct other road users. (ПДД clause 8.1)
How should you act when turning right?
Move into the right lane, then turn
Continue in the second lane up to the intersection, then turn
Both courses of action are possible

The markings allow a right turn from both lanes, so both options are possible. In such cases, when turning at the intersection, keep to the lane you have chosen. (Horizontal road markings 1.18, ПДД clause 8.5)
Along which path are you allowed to make a U-turn?
Only along A
Only along B
Along either of them

When leaving an intersection of carriageways you must end up on «your» side, i.e. keeping to right-hand traffic, without entering the side for oncoming traffic. Following path «B», you would drive against the traffic on the intersecting road, which is extremely dangerous, as you could collide head-on with a car approaching from the left. Make the U-turn along path «A». (ПДД clause 8.6)
At what speed may you continue driving a passenger car in the left lane outside a built-up area?
Not more than 50 km/h
Not less than 50 km/h and not more than 70 km/h
Not less than 50 km/h and not more than 90 km/h

Above the left lane is sign 4.6 «Minimum speed limit» with plate 8.14 «Traffic lane», which shows the lane the sign applies to. The speed in the left lane must be not less than 50 km/h and must not exceed the limit for passenger cars outside built-up areas, i.e. not more than 90 km/h. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.3)
May the driver of the passenger car pass the lorries outside a built-up area along this path?
Yes
Yes, if the lorries' speed is less than 30 km/h
No

On two-way roads with four or more lanes, overtaking is prohibited. In such situations only passing (advancing) is allowed. Observing the manoeuvring rules, the driver of the passenger car on this section of road may pass any vehicles along various paths, including the one shown. (ПДД clause 9.2)
In which case is the driver allowed to park the car at the indicated place?
Only if the distance to the solid marking line is at least 3 m
Only if the distance to the edge of the intersecting carriageway is at least 5 m
If both of the listed conditions are met

The driver does not break the stopping and parking rules. The distances to the edge of the carriageway and to the solid marking line are respected – not less than allowed. Stopping and parking beyond a pedestrian crossing is also allowed. The correct answer is: if both listed conditions are met. (ПДД clause 12.4)
When turning right you must give way:
Only to the cyclist
Only to the pedestrians
To the pedestrians and the cyclist
To nobody

When turning right or left, the driver must give way to pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road he is turning into, to persons using personal mobility devices and to cyclists, whether the intersection is regulated or unregulated. (ПДД clause 13.1)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. Whom must you give way to?
Both trams
Only tram A
Only tram B
Nobody

The intersection is of equal roads. Under equal conditions trams have priority over trackless vehicles. Between themselves they follow the «right-hand rule». Tram «A» has an obstruction on its right. So tram «B» goes first, then «A», and you go last. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the bus
Only the passenger car
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority, and between themselves drivers follow the «right-hand rule». Giving way to nobody, you go first, the bus second, and the passenger car last, as it is on the secondary road. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue beyond the sign?
60 km/h
50 km/h
30 km/h
20 km/h
In the residential zone you are entering, according to the sign, the speed must not exceed 20 km/h. (Road signs 5.21, ПДД clause 10.2)
To carry people on a motorcycle the driver must hold a driving licence:
Of category «A» or subcategory «A1»
Of any category or subcategory for 2 years or more
Only of category «A» or subcategory «A1» for 2 years or more
People may be carried on a motorcycle by a driver who has held a driving licence of category «A» or subcategory «A1» for 2 years or more. (ПДД clause 22.2(1))
With which fault is the operation of the vehicle permitted?
The fuel tank locking devices do not work
The driver's seat adjustment mechanism and locking device do not work
The windscreen demister does not work
The window lifter does not work

All the faults in the answers, except a non-working window lifter, are in the «List of faults». A non-working window lifter is not in that list, so it cannot be a reason to prohibit operation of the vehicle. («List of faults» clauses 8.3, 9.2)
When the car's right wheels run onto a soft, wet shoulder, it is recommended to:
Brake and stop completely
Brake and smoothly steer the car back onto the carriageway
Without braking, smoothly steer the car back onto the carriageway
This situation is dangerous because a turning moment arises that tends to spin the car. Try to return the car smoothly to the carriageway without changing speed.
What is meant by the driver's reaction time?
The time from the moment the driver detects a danger until the vehicle comes to a complete stop
The time from the moment the driver detects a danger until he starts taking measures to avoid it
The time needed to move the foot from the accelerator pedal to the brake pedal

The driver's reaction time is the time from the moment the driver detects a danger until he starts taking measures to avoid it. Reaction time is not constant. It depends mainly on age and how the driver feels at that moment. A slower reaction can be compensated by reducing speed. (Vehicle driving technique)
How many traffic lanes does this road have?
Two
Four
Five
The central reservation divides the road into carriageways. This road has two carriageways and four traffic lanes. (ПДД clause 1.2)
May you drive onto the bridge first?
Yes
Yes, if you do not hinder the oncoming car
No
Sign 2.7 «Priority over oncoming traffic» gives you the right to pass first through the narrow section of road, i.e. over the bridge. (Road signs, ПДД clause 1.2, term «Give way»)
Are you allowed to stop to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed only on even dates of the month
Allowed only on odd dates of the month
Prohibited
Sign 3.29 «No parking on odd dates of the month» restricts only parking. Stopping within its zone is not prohibited at any time. (Road signs)
What is prohibited in the zone of this sign?
Movement of any vehicles
Movement of all vehicles at a speed of not more than 20 km/h
Movement of motor vehicles

Sign 5.33 «Pedestrian zone» marks the start of an area (road section) where only pedestrians and persons equated to them are allowed (people in wheelchairs without an engine, people pushing a bicycle, moped or motorcycle, pulling a sledge, a cart, a pram or a wheelchair), as well as cyclists and users of personal mobility devices in the cases set out in ПДД clauses 24.2, 24.3, 24.4 and 24.6. Entry into this zone, and so the movement of any motor vehicles in it, is prohibited. (Road signs, term «Pedestrian», ПДД clause 1.2)
Are you allowed to enter the reversible-traffic lane if the reversible traffic light is switched off?
Allowed
Allowed if the bus's speed is less than 30 km/h
Prohibited
When the signals of the reversible traffic light above a lane marked on both sides with marking 1.9 are switched off, entering this lane is prohibited. (ПДД clause 6.7)
An information light section in the form of a pedestrian silhouette and an arrow with a flashing white-moon signal, placed under the traffic light, informs the driver that:
At the pedestrian crossing in the direction he is turning, the traffic light permits pedestrians to cross
At the pedestrian crossing in the direction he is turning, the traffic light prohibits pedestrians from crossing
He is turning towards a pedestrian crossing

An information light section in the form of a pedestrian silhouette and an arrow with a flashing white-moon signal, placed under the traffic light, informs the driver that at the pedestrian crossing in the direction he is turning, the traffic light permits pedestrians to cross. The arrow points to the pedestrian crossing where pedestrians have a green signal. (ПДД clause 6.4)
The raised arm of the passenger car's driver is a signal informing you that he intends to:
Turn right
Continue straight ahead
Slow down in order to stop and give way to the motorcycle

The driver's light signals do not work, so he has to give the signals by hand. According to sign 2.4 «Give way», the motorcyclist has priority. A raised arm shows the intention to slow down in order to give way to the motorcyclist. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Driving in the left lane, the driver intends to move into the right lane. In which picture must he give way?
In the left one
In the right one
In both

In the left picture, priority belongs to the car travelling in the same direction in its lane without changing direction, i.e. the «owner of the lane». The driver in the left lane gives way. In the right picture both change lanes at the same time. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. The driver also coming from the left lane has the obstruction on his right, so he gives way in this situation too. (ПДД clause 8.4)
May you make a U-turn at this place?
Yes
Yes, only if no train is approaching
No

U-turns are prohibited on a level crossing, whose limits are the barriers or, if there are none, signs 1.3.1 «Single-track railway» or 1.3.2 «Multi-track railway». Here the level crossing has no barrier. You may make the U-turn along the path shown, since you do it at a safe distance from the railway tracks. (ПДД clause 8.11)
In which cases is it allowed to drive over broken marking lines that divide the carriageway into lanes?
Only if there are no other vehicles on the road
Only when driving in the hours of darkness
Only when changing lanes
In all of the listed cases
Driving over broken marking lines is allowed only when changing lanes. (ПДД clause 9.7)
Are you allowed to overtake the motorcycle?
Allowed
Allowed if the motorcyclist has slowed down
Prohibited

The intersection is of equal roads. At intersections of equal roads, overtaking any vehicle is prohibited for all vehicles. The motorcyclist is slowing down to give way to the obstruction on his right. You must do the same. Otherwise you would break both the overtaking rules and the rules for passing intersections. (ПДД clauses 11.4, 13.11)
Are you allowed to stop at the indicated place?
Allowed
Allowed if the car will be not closer than 5 m to the edge of the intersecting carriageway
Prohibited
At a roundabout you may stop and park, but the distance between the stopped vehicle and the edge of the carriageway must be at least 5 m. (ПДД clauses 12.4, 12.5)
You intend to turn left. Whom must you give way to?
Only the pedestrians
Only the bus
The bus and the pedestrians

The intersection is regulated. The priority signs «do not apply». When turning left you give way to the bus going straight ahead from the opposite direction and to the pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road you are turning into. (ПДД clauses 13.1, 13.3, 13.4)
In which case do you have priority?
Only when turning right
Only when turning left
In both of the listed cases

The intersection is of equal roads. Drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You have priority both when turning right and when turning left, i.e. in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Must the motorcyclist give way to you?
Yes
No

The motorcyclist is entering a road marked with sign 5.1 «Motorway», which is a priority road in relation to the adjoining one. At an intersection of unequal roads, vehicles on the priority road have priority. The motorcyclist must give way to you. (ПДД clauses 1.2, 13.9)
Is the driver allowed to drive around the lorry?
Allowed
Allowed if the distance between the barrier and the stopped lorry is more than 5 m
Prohibited

The passenger car driver wants to drive around the lorry standing in front of the closed barrier. The rules for driving across a level crossing prohibit such a manoeuvre (entering the lane for oncoming traffic). (ПДД clause 15.3)
In which of the listed cases is towing with a flexible tow prohibited?
Only on mountain roads
Only in icy conditions
Only in the hours of darkness and in conditions of insufficient visibility
In all of the listed cases

Remember this answer. In the exam people often answer «only on mountain roads», probably because they associate height with danger. The rules prohibit towing with a flexible tow only in icy conditions. (ПДД clause 20.4)
The operation of motorcycles and mopeds (category L) is prohibited if the remaining tyre tread depth (without wear indicators) is not more than:
0.8 mm
1.0 mm
1.6 mm
2.0 mm
For powered two-wheelers of category L, operation is prohibited when the remaining tyre tread depth (without wear indicators) is 0.8 mm or less. («List of faults» clause 5.4)
Does an anti-lock braking system rule out a skid or a drift when going through a bend?
It completely rules out only a skid
It completely rules out only a drift
It does not rule out a drift or a skid

Anti-lock braking systems (ABS) are brake control systems with feedback that prevent the wheels from locking during braking, thus keeping the car steerable and stable. This system has a «big plus», but also a «minus». With a fast (not emergency) press on the brake pedal on a mixed, even hard, road surface it may activate. While it is active (1–2 seconds) the driver cannot influence braking. To get used to driving when the ABS activates, do a few «test» brakings on a completely empty section of road or area. In a bend, centrifugal force acts on the car. In such situations the ABS cannot affect whether a drift or a skid occurs.
In which cases should cardiopulmonary resuscitation of a casualty be started?
If there is pain in the heart area and difficulty breathing
If the casualty is unconscious, whether or not he is breathing
If the casualty has no consciousness, no breathing and no circulation
In the comments on medical questions, «key words» are used to help remember the correct answer. The correct answer is: if the casualty has no consciousness, no breathing and no circulation.
Coming out of the unpaved road onto the intersection, you are entering:
A priority road
A road of equal status, since there are no priority signs
A road of equal status, since the carriageway is paved before the intersection
A paved road has priority over an unpaved one. The intersection is of unequal roads. You are on the secondary road and will be entering the priority road. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Priority road»)
Where must you stop?
Before the sign (A)
Before the intersection (B)
Before the edge of the intersecting carriageway (C)

When sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping» is placed immediately before an intersection of carriageways, the driver must stop at the stop line. If there is none (as here), the driver must stop before the boundary of the carriageways, i.e. without crossing line «C». Keep in mind that such places are dangerous and are often «under special control» of ГИБДД inspectors. So always fulfil the main condition – the mandatory stop. This will keep you out of conflict situations and keep you safe. (Road signs)
You must drive at a speed of not more than 40 km/h:
Only while it is raining
During precipitation (rain, hail, snow)
Whenever the road surface is wet
Plate 8.16 «Wet surface» indicates that the sign applies during the time when the road surface is wet. (Road signs)
Which of these signs is placed at the beginning of a one-way road?
Only A
Only B
B or D
B or C
Sign «B» is 5.5 «One-way road». (Road signs)
May you stop at this place to pick up or drop off passengers?
Yes
Yes, if this does not obstruct route vehicles
No

Here the stop for route vehicles is marked with the corresponding sign and the yellow zigzag marking 1.17.1. Stopping at this place is allowed if you stop to pick up or drop off passengers and do not obstruct route vehicles or vehicles used as passenger taxis. (Road signs, Horizontal road markings, ПДД clause 12.4)
When turning right you:
Have the right to go through the intersection first
Must give way only to the pedestrians
Must give way to the car with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on, and also to the pedestrians

The intersection is regulated. An emergency vehicle with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on may depart from a number of the Rules' requirements. In this situation all drivers must let it pass through the intersection unobstructed. After it has passed, when turning right you also give way to the pedestrians. (ПДД clauses 3.2, 13.1)
In which cases must the driver not signal with the direction indicators?
Only when there are no other road users on the road
Only if the signal may mislead other road users
In both of the listed cases
Direction indicators must be switched on in good time before starting a manoeuvre and switched off immediately after it is completed. The signal must not mislead other road users. (ПДД clause 8.2)
You are allowed to turn right:
Only along path A
Only along path B
Along either of the paths shown
When turning right, the vehicle must keep as close as possible to the right-hand edge of the carriageway. You can do so, so you continue along path «A». (ПДД clause 8.6)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn at the intersection along the path shown?
Allowed
Allowed if visibility of the road is at least 100 m
Prohibited

There is an intersection ahead. Before turning or making a U-turn there, you had to move into the leftmost lane. You did not do so in time. A U-turn along this path is a violation. (ПДД clauses 8.5, 8.8)
In which lane may you drive at the maximum permitted speed outside a built-up area?
Only in the right one
Only in the left one
In any lane

This is outside a built-up area. Here it is prohibited to occupy the left lanes when the right ones are free. In this situation you must change lanes and continue only in the right lane. (ПДД clause 9.4)
In which case may a driver start overtaking if this manoeuvre is not prohibited on this section of road?
Only if the lane intended for oncoming traffic is clear for a distance sufficient for overtaking
Only if nobody is overtaking his vehicle
If both conditions are met

When doing a «classic» overtaking manoeuvre you must take three mandatory conditions into account, so that you obstruct nobody: 1) oncoming traffic, 2) vehicles behind you, 3) the vehicle being overtaken. (ПДД clauses 11.1, 11.2, Vehicle driving technique)
Which of the drivers has broken the parking rules?
Both
Only the car driver
Only the motorcyclist
Nobody

A passenger car may drive onto the pavement next to the carriageway only where sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» is placed with one of plates 8.6.2, 8.6.3, 8.6.6–8.6.9 «Method of parking the vehicle». There are no such signs here, so the car driver is the «offender». The motorcyclist does not break the stopping and parking rules: they prohibit stopping where the distance between a solid marking line and the stopped vehicle is less than 3 m. Here he is next to a broken line, which does not contradict the Rules. (ПДД clause 12.2)
When driving straight ahead you:
Must stop before the stop line
May continue through the intersection without stopping
Must give way to vehicles coming from other directions

The intersection is regulated. In this case the priority signs, including sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping», «do not apply», according to the order of priority of traffic control means: we do not follow them. The traffic light is green. You continue through the intersection without stopping. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 6.15, 13.3)
You intend to turn right. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the passenger car
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is of equal roads. To decide the order of passage, drivers follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. When turning right you have no obstruction on your right, as your path does not cross the motorcycle's path. You go through the intersection first. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Trams A and B
Tram A and the passenger car
Only tram A
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority; between themselves, trackless vehicles follow the «right-hand rule», giving way to the tram, which has priority under equal conditions. Tram «A» goes first, then you. The passenger car and tram «B» go at the same time, as their paths do not cross. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Which of the drivers has broken the stopping rules?
Only the passenger car driver
Only the lorry driver
Both
On a motorway, stopping and parking outside places specially set aside and marked with the corresponding signs is prohibited. Both drivers are breaking the rules. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 12.1, 16.1)
What equipment must a motor vehicle used for driving instruction have?
Additional clutch pedals (except vehicles with automatic transmission) and brake pedals
A rear-view mirror for the instructor
«Training vehicle» identification signs
All of the listed equipment
The correct answer is all of the listed equipment, according to ПДД clause 21.5 and clause 5 of the Basic Provisions for vehicle admission.
In which cases is the operation of a motorcycle prohibited?
The passengers' footrests or the handles on the saddle have no rubber coating
There is free play in the joints between the motorcycle frame and the sidecar frame
There is no fire extinguisher
Clause 9.8 of the «List of faults» prohibits operating a category L vehicle (motorcycle) if there is free play in the joints between the vehicle frame and the sidecar frame.
In a bend, the rear axle of a front-wheel-drive car starts to skid. What do you do?
Reduce the fuel supply and stabilise the movement with the steering wheel
Brake slightly and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid
Slightly increase the fuel supply, correcting the direction with the steering wheel
Greatly increase the fuel supply without changing the steering wheel position

Front-wheel-drive cars behave very differently from rear-wheel-drive ones. This must be taken into account when driving. Bear in mind that on a straight road a front-wheel-drive car does not tend to skid even at much higher speeds than a rear-wheel-drive car; it holds the road well. But in bends, especially wet or icy ones, if you do not use the «cornering technique», it may not only skid but drift, losing grip on both axles at once. This usually ends in an accident. A skid of the rear axle is «not so bad». In this situation smoothly increase the fuel supply. The grip of the rear wheels will increase. Correct the direction with the steering wheel. (Vehicle driving technique)
What information must you give the dispatcher when calling an ambulance after a road accident?
Name well-known landmarks nearest to the accident. Report the number of casualties, their sex and age
Give the street and number of the building nearest to the accident. Report who was injured (pedestrian, driver or passengers) and describe their injuries

Give the place of the accident (street, building number and well-known landmarks nearest to it). Report the number of casualties, their sex, approximate age, whether they are conscious, breathing and have circulation, and whether there is severe bleeding, fractures or other injuries. Wait until the dispatcher confirms the call has been accepted.

The fullest information lets the ambulance service decide how many medical teams to send and with what specialisation, makes it easier to choose the route and shortens the arrival time of the ambulance and other services.
How many traffic lanes does the carriageway of this road have?
One lane
Two lanes
Three lanes

The solid horizontal marking line 1.1 is used often. It can separate traffic flows or mark lane boundaries. Here it separates the traffic flows of one narrow carriageway which, judging by the car, has one lane in each direction, i.e. two. The motorcyclists ride in one lane in two rows, which is not prohibited for them. (Horizontal road markings, ПДД clauses 1.2, 9.1)
These signs warn you:
That there are dangerous bends in 500 m
That 150–300 m beyond the sign a 500 m section of road with dangerous bends begins
That a 500 m section with dangerous bends begins immediately beyond the sign
Plate 8.2.1 «Zone of effect» shows the length of the series of dangerous bends, the first of which – to the left – begins in 150–300 m. (Road signs 8.2.1, 1.12.2)
Which of these signs applies only to the lane above which it is placed?
Only A
Only B
B and C
The sign with plate 8.14 «Traffic lane» («A») shows the lane to which the sign or traffic light applies. (Road signs)
You are towing a broken-down car. In which lane may you continue in a built-up area?
Only in the right one
Only in the left one
In any lane

Sign 5.15.3 «Beginning of lane» is placed in your direction of travel. In the main lane, sign 4.6 «Minimum speed limit» sets a minimum speed of at least 60 km/h. A driver who cannot continue at this speed must move into the right lane. Towing motor vehicles may drive at not more than 50 km/h. You must continue only in the right lane. (Road signs, ПДД clause 10.4)
What does the «STOP» marking on the carriageway mean?
It warns of the approach to a stop line before a regulated intersection
It warns of the approach to a stop line and the sign «No passing without stopping»
It warns of the approach to the sign «Give way»
Marking 1.21 (the word «STOP») warns of the approach to a stop line (marking 1.12) when it is used together with sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping». (Horizontal road markings)
Which vehicles are allowed to go straight ahead?
Only the lorry
The passenger car and the lorry
The lorry and the bus
All of the listed vehicles

The intersection is regulated. On this carriageway traffic is controlled lane by lane. The red signal of the rightmost traffic light prohibits movement from the rightmost lane. From the middle lane, going straight ahead is allowed. From the leftmost lane, turning left and U-turns are allowed. With these signals, only the lorry is allowed to go straight ahead. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 6.3)
You intend to continue along the priority road. Must you switch on the right direction indicator?
Yes
Yes, only if there is a vehicle moving behind
No

Whichever way you turn at the intersection, left or right, following the priority road, you must switch on the corresponding direction indicator. In this situation, switch on the right indicator. The answer is «yes». (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.1)
Who must give way?
The lorry driver
The passenger car driver

Sign 5.15.5 «End of lane» marks the end of an additional climbing lane or an acceleration lane. In any case, when moving out of it you must give way to vehicles travelling in the same direction without changing direction. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.4)
You may make a U-turn:
Only along path A
Only along path B
Along either of the paths shown

When there are tram tracks in the same direction on your left, level with the carriageway, to make a U-turn you must move onto the tram tracks in advance and then make the manoeuvre, without obstructing the tram. You may make the U-turn only along path «B». (ПДД clauses 8.5, 9.6)
In which lane of the carriageway may a vehicle drive in a built-up area if for technical reasons it cannot reach a speed above 40 km/h?
Only in the rightmost lane
Not further than the second lane
In any lane except the leftmost

Vehicles whose speed must not exceed 40 km/h, or which for technical reasons cannot reach that speed, must keep to the rightmost lane, regardless of where and on which road they are driving. The exceptions are going around an obstacle, overtaking, or changing lanes before turning or making a U-turn. (ПДД clause 9.5)
Are you allowed to overtake the motorcycle?
Allowed
Allowed only after passing the intersection
Prohibited

Overtaking is prohibited at unregulated intersections when driving on a road that is not the priority road. According to sign 2.1 «Priority road», both you and the motorcyclist are on the priority road. So you may overtake. (Road signs, ПДД clause 11.4)
Are you allowed to stop at this place to pick up a passenger?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited
At stops for route vehicles, stopping to pick up or drop off passengers is allowed, provided route vehicles are not obstructed. (ПДД clause 12.4)
You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the oncoming vehicle
Give way only to the car with a flashing beacon and a special sound signal switched on
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is regulated. The emergency vehicle with special signals goes first; it may depart from the traffic light signals. Other drivers must let it pass through the intersection unobstructed. The lorry driver must give way to you, i.e. to the vehicle going straight ahead from the opposite direction. (ПДД clauses 3.1, 3.2, 13.3, 13.4)
Whom must you give way to when turning right?
Only the pedestrian crossing the carriageway at the unregulated pedestrian crossing
Only the pedestrians crossing the carriageway you are turning into
All the pedestrians

First you must give way to the pedestrian on the unregulated pedestrian crossing (ПДД clause 14.1). Then, when turning right, you give way to the pedestrians crossing the carriageway of the road you are turning into (ПДД clause 13.1). You must do the same for users of personal mobility devices. This rule applies at both regulated and unregulated intersections.
How should you act when making a U-turn?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the passenger car
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. When turning left or making a U-turn you give way to vehicles going straight ahead from the opposite direction. In this situation you give way only to the passenger car. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.12)
Which of the listed actions are prohibited for drivers of motor vehicles in a residential zone?
Through traffic
Learner driving
Parking with the engine running
All of the listed actions
Through traffic, learner driving and parking with the engine running are prohibited in residential zones and courtyard areas. (ПДД clauses 17.2, 17.4)
What distance must there be between the towing and the towed vehicle when towing with a rigid tow bar?
Not more than 4 m
From 4 to 6 m
From 6 to 8 m
When towing with a rigid tow bar, the distance between the towing and the towed vehicle must be not more than 4 m. (ПДД clause 20.3)
In which case is the operation of the vehicle permitted?
Optical elements not provided for by the design of the light are fitted
The headlight adjustment does not meet the requirements
The lenses of the external lights are missing or damaged
Lights with orange light are fitted at the front of the vehicle

Section 3, «Lighting and light signalling devices», of the «List of faults» prohibits operation if optical elements not provided for by the light's design are fitted, if the headlight adjustment does not meet the requirements, or if the lenses of external lights are missing or damaged (clauses 3.1, 3.2, 3.3). The list allows operation of a vehicle with orange lights fitted at the front. («List of faults», clause 3.6)
What should a driver do to prevent the dangerous consequences of a skid caused by a sharp turn of the steering wheel on a slippery road?
Quickly but smoothly turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid, then straighten the path by steering ahead of the car's movement
Disengage the clutch and turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid
Press the brake pedal and straighten the path with the steering wheel

To avoid having to fight skids on a slippery road, do not brake sharply, change direction abruptly or play with the accelerator. Choose a speed that gives reliable grip of the wheels on the road. These are basic precautions. In this situation, «without panic», act only with the steering wheel.
How should the hands be placed on the casualty's chest during cardiopulmonary resuscitation?

The bases of the palms of both hands, with fingers interlocked, are placed on the chest two fingers above the xiphoid process, so that the thumb of one hand points towards the casualty's left shoulder and the other towards the right shoulder. The arms are straight at the elbows.

The base of the palm of one hand is placed on the middle of the chest two fingers above the xiphoid process, the other hand is placed on top, and the fingers are interlocked. The arms are straight at the elbows, the thumbs point to the chin and the abdomen. Compressions must be done without jerky movements.

Pressure on the breastbone is applied with the base of the palm of one hand placed on the chest two fingers above the xiphoid process. The arm is straight at the elbow. The direction of the thumb does not matter.

Note that in the correct answer «the palms of both hands are placed one on top of the other», because chest compressions require a lot of physical effort. By order of the Russian Ministry of Health and Social Development of 04.05.2012 No. 477н, the term «indirect heart massage» was replaced by «pressing on the casualty's breastbone with the hands». The heart is in the middle of the chest, behind the breastbone, two fingers above its xiphoid process (the triangular bone at the lower end of the breastbone).
How many carriageways does this road have?
One
Two
Four
Horizontal marking 1.3 does not divide the road into carriageways. So in this situation the road has four traffic lanes and one carriageway. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Central reservation»)
With which sign must the driver give way if passing oncoming vehicles is difficult?
Only C
A and C
B and C
B and D

On gradients marked with signs «A» 1.13 «Steep descent» and «B» 1.14 «Steep ascent», if there is an obstacle, the driver of the vehicle going downhill must give way. On narrow sections of road where passing oncoming vehicles is difficult, the following signs are placed: on one side «C» 2.6 «Priority of oncoming traffic», on the other side «D» 2.7 «Priority over oncoming traffic». Here, if passing is difficult, entering the narrow section from the side of sign 2.6 is prohibited. The answer is signs «A» and «C». (Road signs)
Are you allowed to park at the indicated place?
Allowed
Allowed only in daylight
Prohibited

Sign 3.27 «No stopping» applies from where it is placed to the nearest intersection, or if there is none, to the end of the built-up area – here to sign 5.24.1 «End of built-up area». You have the right to stop on the shoulder beyond the sign. (Road signs)
Has the lorry driver broken the parking rules?
Yes
No, if the lorry's permitted maximum weight is not more than 3.5 t
No

In a pavement-side parking area marked with signs 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» and 8.6.4 «Method of parking the vehicle», only passenger cars and motorcycles may be parked in the way shown. Lorries, whatever their permitted maximum weight, may not park there. This driver has broken the Rules. Do not confuse plate 8.6.4 «Method of parking the vehicle» with plate 8.4.3 «Type of vehicle», or you will make a mistake. (Road signs)
What does the vertical marking on the road barrier warn you about?
The approach to a level crossing
The approach to a dangerous intersection
Driving on a dangerous section of road
Vertical marking 2.5 marks the sides of road barriers on small-radius bends, steep descents and other dangerous sections.
May a driver continue after the green traffic light changes to yellow if he could stop before the intersection only by emergency braking?
Yes
Yes, if the driver intends to go only straight through the intersection
No

Emergency (as hard as possible) braking is used only to prevent a road accident. So the rules allow you to continue «on yellow» if stopping would require emergency braking. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 6.14, 10.5)
The motorcyclist's raised arm is a signal informing you that he intends to:
Continue straight ahead
Turn right
Slow down in order to stop and give way to the passenger car
The intersection is of equal roads. The motorcyclist has an obstruction on his right. He must give way, i.e. brake and stop. His raised arm signals this. (ПДД clauses 8.1, 13.11)
In which directions may you continue from the left lane in a lorry with a permitted maximum weight of not more than 3.5 t?
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead and right
Straight ahead, left and in the opposite direction

According to plate 8.4.1 «Type of vehicle», the sign applies to lorries, including those with a trailer, with a permitted maximum weight of more than 3.5 t. It does not apply to you, so from your lane you may continue straight ahead, turn left or make a U-turn to drive in the opposite direction. (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.5)
You need to turn onto the road adjoining on the right. What do you do?
Without changing lanes, reduce speed, then move into the deceleration lane
Without changing speed, move into the deceleration lane, then reduce speed
Both courses of action are possible
Speed must be reduced only in the deceleration lane. (ПДД clause 8.10)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue driving a passenger car with a trailer outside a built-up area?
50 km/h
60 km/h
70 km/h
80 km/h
90 km/h
Outside built-up areas, on roads other than motorways, a passenger car with a trailer may drive at not more than 70 km/h. (ПДД clause 10.3)
Are you allowed to overtake?
Allowed
Allowed if the overtaking is completed before the intersection
Prohibited

Overtaking is prohibited at intersections of equal roads. But according to sign 2.3.1 «Intersection with a secondary road», you are travelling along the priority road. You may overtake. (Road signs, ПДД clause 11.4)
Which of the drivers has broken the parking rules?
Both
Only the driver of car A
Only the driver of car B
Nobody

Vehicles may be parked in one row parallel to the edge of the carriageway. This also applies to a local widening of the carriageway (as here). The exception is such places marked with sign 6.4 combined with one of plates 8.6.1–8.6.9. The driver of car «A» is breaking the parking rules. (ПДД clause 12.2)
You intend to make a U-turn. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Make the U-turn, giving way to the passenger car
Wait until the traffic controller lowers his right arm

The intersection is regulated. The traffic controller's right arm is extended forward. From his left side, vehicles may continue in any direction, observing the rules for positioning vehicles on the carriageway. Making a U-turn from the leftmost lane, you will have an obstruction on your right. You give way to the passenger car turning right. (ПДД clauses 6.10, 13.4)
Whom must you give way to when going straight ahead?
Only the tram
Only the passenger car
Both vehicles

The intersection is of equal roads. Under equal conditions the tram has priority, and trackless vehicles follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. In this situation you give way only to the tram. (ПДД clause 13.11)
How should you act when turning left?
Go through the intersection first
Give way only to the lorry with the flashing beacon switched on
Give way to both vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. A yellow flashing beacon on the lorry does not give it priority. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. You go first; after you, the vehicles on the secondary road go, following the «right-hand rule» between themselves. The passenger car goes second, the lorry last. (ПДД clauses 3.4, 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Are you allowed to drive over the level crossing?
Allowed, since the crossing attendant prohibits movement only for the oncoming car
Allowed if no train is approaching
Prohibited

The crossing attendant's prohibiting signal is when he faces drivers with a baton, a red lamp or a flag raised above his head, or with his arms extended to the sides. Entering the crossing is then prohibited both from his chest side and from his back side (remember: «chest or back – a wall»). (ПДД clause 15.3)
In which cases may the horn be used in built-up areas?
Only to warn of the intention to overtake
Only to prevent a road traffic accident
In both of the listed cases
The horn may be used only: – to warn other drivers of the intention to overtake outside built-up areas; – when it is necessary to prevent a road traffic accident. (ПДД clause 19.10)
Up to what maximum total free play in the steering is the operation of a passenger car allowed?
10 degrees
20 degrees
25 degrees
The total free play in the steering of a passenger car must not exceed 10 degrees. («List of faults» clause 2.3)
How should the driver act when getting out of a car standing by the pavement or on the shoulder?
Walk around the car in front
Walk around the car behind
Both courses of action are allowed

The Rules do not regulate how the driver gets out of the car. But for road safety, in most such cases you should walk around the car behind it, so that you can see vehicles moving in the same direction. The main safety condition when getting out of the car in such situations is that the actions of the driver and others must not take other drivers by surprise.
When driving in fog, the distance to objects seems:
Greater than it really is
As it really is
Shorter than it really is

When driving in fog, the distance to objects seems greater than it really is. This is a psychological effect: people compare everything with the familiar conditions in which they spend most of their time, i.e. daytime.
What is meant by the permitted maximum weight of a vehicle?
The maximum weight of cargo allowed to be carried, set by the manufacturer
The weight of the vehicle in running order without the driver, passengers and cargo, set by the manufacturer
The weight of the vehicle in running order with cargo, driver and passengers, set by the manufacturer as the maximum allowed
ПДД clause 1.2, term «Permitted maximum weight».
Are you allowed to continue?
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead or in the opposite direction
In all directions
Sign 3.18.2 «No left turn» does not prohibit U-turns. So you may, as you wish, continue straight ahead or make a U-turn and continue in the opposite direction. (Road signs)
Which of these signs allow you to drive a car to your place of residence or work?
Only A
Only C
A and C
All of them

The signs that allow driving to your place of residence or work are «A» 3.2 «No vehicles» and «C» 3.3 «No motor vehicles». Six prohibitory signs give such an «exemption». Sign «B» 3.1 «No entry» is not one of them: it prohibits entry for all vehicles except route vehicles, and vehicles when sign 3.1 is used with plates 8.4.1–8.4.8; 8.5.1–8.5.7 and 8.4.9–8.4.16. (Road signs)
What do these road signs mean?
A parking place only for buses
A parking place for buses and trolleybuses
A parking place where you can change to a route vehicle (bus or trolleybus)

Sign 6.4 «Parking (parking place)» is used with plate 8.21.2 «Type of route vehicle». This combination shows that from this place you can continue by route vehicle – bus or trolleybus – and leave your car in the equipped car park. (Road signs)
The triangle-shaped marking in the lane:
Marks a dangerous section of road
Warns you of the approach to a place where you must give way
Shows the place where you must stop
Marking 1.20 warns of the approach to marking 1.13, which shows where the driver must stop if necessary to give way to vehicles on the intersecting road. (Horizontal road markings)
May you continue if the traffic controller raises his arm after you have entered the intersection?
Yes
Yes, if you are turning right
No
You are in the intersection. You must clear it, otherwise you will obstruct vehicles coming from other directions. (ПДД clause 6.14)
You intend to continue along the priority road. Must you switch on the left direction indicator?
Yes
Yes, if vehicles are approaching from other directions
No

Wherever you drive, you must strictly follow your «own inner rule»: «My driving is safe when my actions are understood by all other road users». You intend to make a manoeuvre – a left turn – so you must inform other road users by switching on the direction indicator. (ПДД clause 8.1)
Who must give way when both change lanes towards each other?
The passenger car driver
The lorry driver
The drivers should act by mutual agreement
When changing lanes at the same time, drivers follow the «right-hand rule». The lorry driver has an obstruction on his right. He gives way. (ПДД clause 8.4)
In which directions may you continue?
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead and left
Straight ahead, left and in the opposite direction

On your side is broken marking line 1.11, which may be crossed. Since you are in the leftmost lane, you may continue straight ahead, turn left, or make a U-turn and continue in the opposite direction. (Horizontal road markings, ПДД clause 8.5)
What is the maximum speed at which you may continue in a passenger car?
70 km/h
90 km/h
110 km/h
Faster driving is allowed on motorways. The maximum permitted speed there is 110 km/h. (Road signs 5.1 «Motorway», ПДД clause 10.3)
How should you act in this situation?
Give way to the oncoming car
Go first
Act by mutual agreement with the oncoming driver

On your side of the carriageway there is an obstruction – a broken-down car. You must give way. If the same situation occurred on a gradient marked with signs 1.13 «Steep descent» or 1.14 «Steep ascent», the vehicle going downhill would have to give way. (ПДД clause 11.7)
Are you allowed to park the car at this place?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited

Stopping and parking are prohibited closer than 15 m from route-vehicle stops (this condition is respected), and also on a pedestrian crossing and closer than 5 m before it. Stopping right next to the pedestrian crossing breaks this requirement. So parking here is prohibited. (ПДД clause 12.4)
You intend to turn left. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the tram and turn from the carriageway
Let the tram pass, move onto the tram tracks in the same direction and turn from them

The traffic light with white-moon signals, intended for drivers of route vehicles, allows them to go straight ahead. The green traffic light allows you to go in any direction. To turn left you must let the tram pass, move onto the tram tracks in the same direction and turn left from them. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 6.8, 8.5)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the pedestrians
The pedestrians and the cyclist
Nobody

At intersections, whether regulated or not, when turning left or right the driver must give way to pedestrians crossing the carriageway he is turning into. You must also give way to the cyclist coming straight towards you. (ПДД clauses 13.1, 13.2)
In which case will you have to give way to the traffic police car?
If the police car has blue flashing beacons switched on
If the police car has blue flashing beacons and a special sound signal switched on at the same time
In any case
Here you must give way to the emergency vehicle if it has blue flashing beacons and a special sound signal switched on at the same time. (ПДД clause 3.2)
When approaching a stopped vehicle with hazard warning lights on and «Carriage of children» identification signs, the driver must:
Reduce speed
If necessary, stop and let the children pass
Do all of the listed actions

Hazard warning lights must be switched on when children are getting on or off a bus with «Carriage of children» signs. When approaching such a stopped bus with hazard lights on, the driver must reduce speed and, if necessary, stop and let the children pass, i.e. do all of the listed actions. Note that since 1 March 2023 organised transport of children is allowed only by bus. (ПДД clauses 7.1, 14.7, 22.6)
In which cases do moped riders break the Rules?
Only if they ride without holding the handlebars with at least one hand
Only if they ride on the road without a fastened motorcycle helmet
In both of the listed cases

Moped riders are prohibited from: – riding without holding the handlebars with at least one hand; – riding on the road without a fastened motorcycle helmet. The correct answer is: in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 24.8)
The operation of a car is prohibited if the upper part of the windscreen has a transparent tinted film wider than:
100 millimetres
120 millimetres
130 millimetres
140 millimetres
Clause 4.3 of the «List of faults» prohibits operation of a vehicle if the upper part of the windscreen has a transparent tinted film wider than 140 mm.
When stopping on an uphill (downhill) slope with a shoulder, you can prevent the car from rolling onto the carriageway by turning its front wheels to position:
A and D
B and C
A and C
B and D

Wheels turned towards the ditch («A» and «D») will, if the car rolls unintentionally, take the uncontrolled car into the ditch, avoiding a collision with moving vehicles. The opposite position does the reverse.
The established fact that a driver has consumed substances causing alcohol intoxication is determined by the presence in his body of absolute ethyl alcohol in a concentration exceeding:
0.10 milligrams per litre of exhaled air
0.16 milligrams per litre of exhaled air
0.25 milligrams per litre of exhaled air

Article 12.8 of the КоАП (Code of Administrative Offences), which sets penalties for drunk drivers, applies if the concentration of absolute ethyl alcohol exceeds 0.16 milligrams per litre of exhaled air.

May the owner of a motorcycle with an internal combustion engine of not more than 125 cm³ and a maximum power of not more than 11 kW hand over the driving of this vehicle in his presence to another person, if he has a compulsory civil liability insurance policy on paper or as an electronic document, or a paper copy of it?
Yes, if that person holds a driving licence of category «A» or subcategory «A1»
Yes, if that person holds a driving licence of subcategory «B1»
Yes, if that person holds a driving licence of category «M»
Yes, in all of the listed cases

Article 25 clause 7 of the Federal Law «On Road Traffic Safety» does not prohibit handing over the driving of a vehicle to another person who has a driving licence of the corresponding category or subcategory and the corresponding insurance policy, or a paper printout of the compulsory insurance contract concluded as an electronic document. Here, to ride the motorcycle you need a licence of category A or subcategory A1.
What do these road signs inform you about?
The approach to an intersection where the sign «Give way» is placed
The approach to an intersection where the sign «No passing without stopping» is placed
The approach to customs

Plate 8.1.2 «Distance to object» shows the distance from sign 2.4 «Give way» to the intersection when sign 2.5 «No passing without stopping» is placed immediately before the intersection. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to stop at the indicated place?
Prohibited
Allowed only to pick up and drop off passengers
Allowed

The yellow solid marking line 1.4 marks places where stopping is prohibited. Since 1 March 2023 this marking may be used on its own. It has been removed from the definition of the zone of sign 3.27 «No stopping». In this situation the sign is functionally inactive. Stopping at the indicated place is PROHIBITED. (Road signs, Horizontal road markings)
Which of these signs apply only up to the nearest intersection in the direction of travel?
A and C
B and D
C and D

Signs B – 3.24 «Maximum speed limit» and D – 3.28 «No parking» apply up to the nearest intersection beyond them, and in built-up areas with no intersection, up to the end of the built-up area. Signs A – 5.31 «Zone with maximum speed limit» and C – 5.27 «Zone with parking restriction» are cancelled only by their own signs, 5.32 «End of zone with maximum speed limit» and 5.28 «End of zone with parking restriction». (Road signs)
What do the broken marking lines at the intersection mean?
The mandatory direction of travel at the intersection
Traffic lanes within the intersection
A warning of the approach to a marking that separates traffic flows in opposite or the same directions
Horizontal marking 1.7 marks traffic lanes within the intersection.
You are allowed to go:
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead and right
In any direction

When there is a traffic controller, the traffic light signals «do not apply». From the controller's left side, with his right arm extended forward, trackless vehicles may go in all directions. But since you are in the right lane, you may only go straight ahead or right. (ПДД clause 6.10)
When overtaking, when should you switch off the left direction indicator?
Immediately after moving into the lane intended for oncoming traffic
After passing the vehicle being overtaken
At the driver's discretion

Once you have finished moving into the oncoming lane, you stop signalling immediately. While passing the vehicle in the oncoming lane you do not signal. (ПДД clause 8.2, Vehicle driving technique: Overtaking)
Must the passenger car driver give way to the lorry driver?
Yes
Yes, if the lorry driver starts to move to the right
No
The passenger car driver is the «owner» of the lane, so he does not have to give way. (ПДД clause 8.4)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn on this section of road?
Allowed
Allowed only if visibility of the road is at least 100 m
Prohibited
In your direction of travel the road bends to the right. A U-turn is allowed only if the visibility of the road is more than 100 m. (ПДД clause 8.11)
At what speed may motorcycles drive on motorways outside built-up areas?
Not more than 90 km/h
Not more than 110 km/h
Not more than 130 km/h
Outside built-up areas, motorcycles may drive on motorways at not more than 110 km/h. (ПДД clause 10.3)
At the top of the hill, may you move into the middle lane to pass the lorry?
Yes
Yes, only if visibility of the road is at least 100 m
No

Here the road is clearly divided into lanes: one lane for oncoming traffic and two lanes in your direction. So you may pass even at the top of the hill. But always be careful in such situations, because you cannot see what is happening beyond the crest. Avoid situations where you can be taken completely by surprise. (ПДД clauses 1.2, term «Passing», 11.4)
At which of the places shown may you park a passenger car?
Only A
Only C
A or C
Any of them

This is in a built-up area on a section of road marked with sign 5.5 «One-way road». On such a road, stopping and parking on the left side in the direction of travel (place «A») is allowed. Place «B» is within the zone of sign 3.28 «No parking». So you may park, as you wish, at place «A» or «C». (Road signs)
How should you act when turning left?
Go through the intersection first
Drive past the stop line and stop in the intersection to give way to the oncoming car
Stop before the stop line and turn left after the passenger car has passed

Stopping no further than the stop line is mandatory when the traffic light shows a prohibiting signal. You have «green». You enter the intersection without stopping, and stop before turning left to give way to the passenger car going straight ahead from the opposite direction. (Horizontal road markings, ПДД clauses 6.13, 6.2, 13.3, 13.4)
Are you allowed to enter the intersection when there is a traffic jam beyond it?
Allowed
Allowed if you intend to turn
Prohibited

Here you may enter the intersection only to turn, because the jam makes it impossible to go straight ahead without being forced to stop in the intersection, which would obstruct traffic in the crossing direction. (ПДД clause 13.2)
You intend to continue straight ahead. Whom must you give way to?
Only the motorcycle
The motorcycle and the passenger car
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. After them, vehicles on the secondary road go, using the same rule. You go first, giving way to nobody; the motorcyclist second, the lorry third, and the passenger car last. (Road signs, ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Where may pedestrians walk in a residential zone?
Only on pavements
On pavements and in single file along the edge of the carriageway
On pavements and across the whole width of the carriageway
In residential zones and courtyard areas, pedestrians have priority over motor vehicles. They may walk both on pavements and across the whole width of the carriageway. (ПДД clauses 17.1, 17.4)
Which picture shows a car whose driver is not breaking the rules for carrying cargo?
Only A
Only B
Both

Neither driver is breaking the rules for carrying cargo. In the left picture the load sticks out less than 1 m, so it may be carried without special marking. In the right picture, if it is daytime, the load sticking out more than 1 m is marked, as it should be, with the identification sign «Oversized load». In theory and practice these distances are measured from the external lights, not from the protruding parts of the car. (ПДД clause 23.4)
In which cases is the operation of the vehicle permitted?
The content of harmful substances in the exhaust gases or their smoke opacity exceeds the standards
The fuel supply system and the exhaust system are not airtight
The coolant temperature gauge does not work
The exhaust noise level exceeds the standards

With the following faults, operation is prohibited (clauses 8.1, 8.2, 8.5): harmful substances in the exhaust or smoke opacity exceed the standards; the fuel system is not airtight; the external noise level exceeds the standards. Be especially careful with fuel leaks, which you can notice by the smell. Such a fault can cause a car fire that cannot always be put out. Operation is not prohibited if the coolant temperature gauge does not work. («List of faults»)
Driving through deep snow on an unpaved road should be done:
Changing speed and gear depending on the road conditions
In a lower gear chosen in advance, without sharp turns or stops
In a higher gear chosen in advance, without sharp turns or stops
If the road and the snow cover are even and the section is long, you should drive in a lower gear.
What optimal position should be given to a conscious casualty with a suspected spinal injury?
Lay the casualty on his side
Lay the casualty on his back on a hard flat surface, do not move him unless necessary, do not change his position
Lay the casualty on his back, put a roll of clothing under his neck and raise his legs
The correct answer is «do not move the casualty». Lay the casualty on his back on a hard flat surface, do not move him unless necessary and do not change his position.
What must the drivers involved in a road traffic accident do immediately?
Clear the carriageway
Stop (not move) the vehicle, switch on the hazard warning lights and set out the warning triangle
Report the accident to the police

After an accident, every driver involved must: 1. immediately stop (not move) the vehicle; 2. switch on the hazard warning lights and set out the warning triangle in the lane where the vehicle is, on the side of worse visibility. Then check whether there are casualties and act according to ПДД clauses 2.6, 2.6.1. The first two requirements come first in every accident. (ПДД clause 2.5)
What is special about the speed rules on this section of road?
The recommended speed is 40 km/h
The minimum permitted speed is 40 km/h
The minimum permitted speed in the left lane is 40 km/h

Plate 8.14 «Traffic lane» shows that sign 4.6 «Minimum speed limit» applies only to the lane above which it is placed. As this is in a built-up area, in the right lane you may drive at not more than 60 km/h; in the left lane the speed must be at least 40 km/h and not more than 60 km/h. The correct answer: the minimum permitted speed in the left lane is 40 km/h. (Road signs)
Which of these signs prohibit turning left?
Only A
A and B
A and C
All of them

At an intersection before which sign «A» 5.13.1 «Exit onto a road with a lane for route vehicles» is placed, other vehicles may not turn left. Sign «C» 6.3.1 «U-turn place» also prohibits turning left for all vehicles. Note sign «B» 3.19 «No U-turn», which, on the contrary, does not prohibit turning left. (Road signs)
May you turn right at this intersection?
Yes
Yes, if you live or work in the area to the right of the intersection
No
Sign 6.8.2 «Dead end» shows that the adjoining road has no through route. It introduces no restrictions. You may turn right. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to change lanes?
Allowed only into the neighbouring lane
Allowed if the lorry's speed is less than 30 km/h
Prohibited

The reversible traffic lights are switched off. The double broken marking line 1.9 separates traffic flows in opposite directions. Crossing the broken marking line 1.5 on the left is not prohibited, so you may move into the left (neighbouring) lane and continue in it. (ПДД clause 6.7)
Are you allowed to proceed?
Allowed only to the right
Allowed only to make a U-turn
Prohibited
Remember the old instructor's saying: «an extended right arm (from the controller's right side) is a barrier». Movement is prohibited. (ПДД clause 6.10)
The passenger car driver must switch off the left direction indicator:
After moving into the left lane
After passing the lorry
After returning to the right lane

The path shown has three phases. First, moving into the parallel lane: as soon as you have done it, switch off the left indicator. Second, driving in the parallel lane: no signals. Third, moving back into your previous lane: before it, switch on the right indicator; after it, switch it off. (Vehicle driving technique, ПДД clause 8.1)
Along which path are you allowed to turn left?
Only A
Only B
Along either of them

Without sign 5.15.1 «Lane directions», you would turn left along path «A». But at intersections before which or at which signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 are placed, driving onto the tram tracks is prohibited. The left turn (U-turn) must be made along path «B». (Road signs, ПДД clause 8.5)
You may make a U-turn:
Only along path A
Only along path B
Along either of the paths shown
Sign 3.18.2 «No left turn» does not prohibit U-turns at the intersection before which it is placed. You may make a U-turn along either of the paths shown. (Road signs)
Outside built-up areas you may continue:
In any lane
In the right or middle lane
Only in the right lane
This is outside a built-up area. You may not drive in other lanes when the right lane is free. (ПДД clause 9.4)
After passing the first car, may you continue in the left lane outside built-up areas?
Yes
Yes, if you intend to pass the second car
No

Outside a built-up area, in exactly this situation, with two lanes in your direction, you may stay in the left lane to avoid unnecessary manoeuvres while passing. You must not obstruct vehicles coming behind you at a higher speed. (ПДД clause 9.4)
Has the lorry driver broken the parking rules?
Yes
Yes, if the lorry's permitted maximum weight is more than 2.5 t
No

You may not park on the carriageway here, as the distance between the vehicle and the solid marking line would be less than 3 m, which is not allowed. Lorries of any type may not park partly or fully on the pavement. Only passenger cars and motorcycles may do so, and only where the corresponding signs are placed. This driver has broken the parking rules. (Road signs 6.4, 8.6.2, 8.6.3, 8.6.6–8.6.9; ПДД clauses 12.2, 12.4)
Which of the drivers making a turn will break the Rules?
Both
Only the passenger car driver
Only the motorcyclist
Nobody

Here sign 4.1.1 «Straight ahead» is placed immediately before the intersection of carriageways, i.e. before the intersection. You may only continue straight ahead. Both drivers break the Rules. (Road signs)
You intend to continue straight ahead. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the passenger car
Give way to the passenger car and the motorcycle

The intersection is of equal roads. To decide the order of passage we follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. The trick here is the vehicle that moves forward and stops in the intersection. The passenger car turning left moves first, since at first it has no obstruction on its right. Reaching the middle of the intersection, it stops before turning left, because it must give way to the motorcyclist on its right. Then there is no longer an obstruction on the right of your path, so you go through the intersection first. The motorcyclist goes after you. The driver who moved first finishes last. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the trams
Tram B and the passenger car
All the vehicles

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority. Between themselves, trackless vehicles follow the «right-hand rule», giving way to the tram, which has priority over them under equal conditions. Tram «B» goes first, then the passenger car, then you. Tram «A» goes last, as it is on the secondary road. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.1, 13.11)
Stopping on a motorway is allowed:
Anywhere outside the carriageway
Only to the right of the marking line that shows the edge of the carriageway
Only at special parking areas marked with the corresponding signs
According to ПДД clause 16.1, you may stop on a motorway only at special parking areas marked with the corresponding signs.
Which external lights must be used when driving in the hours of darkness on lit sections of roads in a built-up area?
Only side lights
Dipped headlights
Side lights or dipped headlights
In the hours of darkness, on lit sections of roads in a built-up area, the driver must switch on dipped headlights. (ПДД clause 19.2)
With which fault is further movement of the vehicle prohibited, even to the place of repair or parking?
The service brake system is faulty
The exhaust system is faulty
The windscreen washer does not work
Driving with a faulty service brake system is an obvious danger, so movement is prohibited. (ПДД clause 2.3.1)
A passenger car is more resistant to overturning in a bend:
Without passengers and cargo
Without passengers but with cargo on the roof rack
With passengers but without cargo
With passengers and cargo
The lower and more symmetrical the car's centre of gravity, the more stable it is. An empty car without passengers or cargo is always more resistant to overturning than a loaded one.
How should first aid be given for frostbite and hypothermia?
Rub the affected parts of the body with snow or wool, then keep them warm, give alcohol, move the casualty into a warm room
Keep the affected parts of the body warm and immobilise them, wrap the casualty in warm clothing or a blanket, give a warm drink, move him into a warm room
Smear the affected parts with cream, apply a warming compress and a hot-water bottle, move the casualty into a warm room, give a warm drink

Giving alcohol in the cold is PROHIBITED: it dilates the skin's blood vessels, increasing heat loss. In frostbite and hypothermia, heat loss from the body surface must be reduced as much as possible. So the affected parts are kept warm and immobilised, the casualty is wrapped in warm clothing or a blanket, given a warm drink and moved into a warm room.
What licence is enough for a driver of a passenger car with a trailer whose permitted maximum weight does not exceed 750 kg?
A licence for vehicles of subcategory «B1»
A licence for vehicles of category «B»
A licence for vehicles of category «BE»

According to Article 25 clause 1 of the Federal Law «On Road Traffic Safety», drivers entitled to drive category «B» vehicles may also drive them with a trailer whose permitted maximum weight does not exceed 750 kg, i.e. without an entry in column «E». Here a category «B» licence is needed.
The signs warn you that:
Pedestrians may appear on the carriageway over the next 150 m
There is a pedestrian crossing in 150 m
There is a footpath in 150 m
Under sign 1.22 «Pedestrian crossing» is plate 8.1.1 «Distance to object», which shows the distance to the dangerous place the warning sign refers to. (Road signs)
You are allowed to continue:
Only in direction B
In direction A or B
In direction B or C

According to sign 4.3 «Roundabout», you are entering an intersection where traffic may move only in the direction of the arrows on the sign. Driving against the traffic along path «C» is prohibited. Turning right along path «A» is prohibited by sign 3.18.1 «No right turn». Of the directions shown, you may only continue along path «B». (Road signs)
Which of these signs prohibit vehicles whose speed, according to their technical characteristics or condition, is less than 40 km/h?
Only A
Only C
A and B

What is prohibited on roads marked with sign «A» 5.1 «Motorway» is also prohibited on roads marked with sign «B» 5.3 «Road for motor vehicles». On these roads, vehicles whose speed according to their technical characteristics or condition is less than 40 km/h are prohibited. Sign «C» 6.2 «Recommended speed» applies only to a section of road and does not restrict driving faster or slower on it. (Road signs, ПДД clause 16.1)
May you overtake with this marking?
Yes
Yes, if the tractor's speed is less than 30 km/h
No

Marking 1.11 may be crossed from the broken-line side, and from the solid-line side only when completing an overtaking manoeuvre or going around an obstacle. Here you may overtake, whatever the tractor's speed. (Horizontal road markings)
In which directions does the traffic controller allow you to go?
Only straight ahead
Straight ahead and right
In all directions

With the traffic controller in this position, trackless vehicles from his left and right sides may go straight ahead and right. «Chest or back – a wall»: movement is prohibited for everyone facing his chest or back. (ПДД clause 6.10)
When should the direction indicators be switched on?
Immediately before turning or making a U-turn
In good time before starting the manoeuvre
At your own discretion
Your actions must always be clear to other road users. You must inform them of your intentions in good time before starting the manoeuvre. (ПДД clause 8.2)
Who must give way?
The driver intending to move off from the pavement
The driver intending to stop by the pavement
In this situation the drivers should act by mutual agreement

A driver intending to move off after stopping or parking must signal in the corresponding direction and move off only after making sure the manoeuvre is safe and will not obstruct other road users. (ПДД clause 8.1)
Are you allowed to make a U-turn at this place?
Allowed
Allowed if this does not obstruct route vehicles
Prohibited
U-turns at stops for route vehicles are prohibited in all circumstances. (ПДД clause 8.11)
Along which path are you allowed to continue?
Only A
Only B
Along either of them

Drivers turning onto a road with reversible traffic marked with sign 5.10 must keep to the rightmost lane. They may change lanes only after making sure that traffic in this direction is allowed in the other lanes too. Of the paths shown, you may continue only along path «B». (Road signs, ПДД clause 9.8)
After passing the lorry, may you continue in the left lane outside built-up areas?
Yes
Yes, if you are driving a passenger car
No

After passing, the driver should move back into the lane he occupied before, here the right one. Outside built-up areas, drivers must keep as close as possible to the right-hand edge of the carriageway. You can do so, so you continue only in the rightmost lane. (ПДД clause 9.4)
Are you allowed to stop a passenger car at the indicated place?
Allowed
Allowed if you intend to drop off a passenger
Prohibited

In a situation like this the Rules allow stopping and parking only if the distance between the solid marking line and the stopped vehicle is at least 3 m. A passenger car cannot meet this requirement, as any passenger car is wider than 1 m. Stopping here is prohibited. (ПДД clause 12.4)
Are you allowed to enter the intersection when there is a traffic jam beyond it?
Allowed
Allowed if you intend to turn
Prohibited

The intersection is regulated. You have a green light, but there is a jam ahead. If you enter the intersection to go straight ahead, when the signals change you will obstruct traffic, especially in the crossing direction. So you may enter the intersection only to turn right or left. (ПДД clauses 6.2, 13.2) (Answer updated on 14.12.18: you may no longer enter an intersection with a jam if you intend to make a U-turn.)
You intend to continue straight ahead. What do you do?
Go through the intersection first
Give way to the lorry

The intersection is unregulated and of equal roads. To decide the order we follow the «right-hand rule»: whoever has an obstruction on the right gives way. You must give way to the lorry. (ПДД clause 13.11)
Whom must you give way to when turning left?
Only the bus
Only the passenger car
Nobody

The intersection is of unequal roads. The priority road changes direction. Vehicles on the priority road have priority, and follow the «right-hand rule» between themselves. You have no obstruction on your right. You go first, the passenger car after you, and the bus last, as it is on the secondary road. (ПДД clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11)
Is reversing allowed on a motorway?
Allowed
Allowed if the vehicle is to the right of the solid marking line showing the edge of the motorway carriageway
Prohibited
Reversing on a motorway is prohibited. (ПДД clause 16.1)
Moped riders are allowed to ride:
Only along the right edge of the carriageway in single file
Only on the shoulder, if this does not obstruct pedestrians
Only in the cycle lane
In all of the listed cases
Moped riders are allowed to ride in all of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 24.7)
Further movement of the vehicle (even to the place of parking or repair) with unlit (missing) headlights and rear side lights is prohibited:
Only in conditions of insufficient visibility
Only in the hours of darkness
In both of the listed cases

Driving with this fault – unlit (missing) headlights and rear side lights – is prohibited in the hours of darkness or in conditions of insufficient visibility. The correct answer: in both of the listed cases. (ПДД clause 2.3.1)
The way of making a U-turn using the adjacent territory on the left that ensures road safety is shown:
Only in the left picture
Only in the right picture
In both pictures
The most rational and safe way to make a U-turn in the situations shown is in the right picture. It gives a better view of the carriageway and takes less time.
The probability of an accident when driving in dense traffic will be lower if your vehicle's speed is:
Much lower than the average speed of the traffic
Close to the average speed of the traffic
Much higher than the average speed of the traffic
Your car should move like the rest of the traffic. Lane changes should be kept to a minimum. A driver who does not follow these conditions creates unnecessary dangerous situations.
A priority road is shown:
Only in the upper left picture
In the upper left and lower pictures
In all the pictures

A priority road is shown in the upper left and lower pictures, where there are priority signs before the intersection. In the upper right picture, sign 6.8.2 «Dead end» is placed before the intersection; it is an information sign, and this intersection is of equal roads. (ПДД clause 1.2, term «Priority road», Road signs)
Which of these signs apply only during the time when the road surface is wet?
Only A
A and B
All of them

Only the combination «A» – 3.24 «Maximum speed limit» with plate 8.16 «Wet surface», which shows that the sign applies when the road surface is wet – is the correct answer. Sign «B» 1.18 «Loose chippings» warns of a section where gravel, crushed stone, etc. may be thrown up from under the wheels. Sign «C» 1.15 «Slippery road» warns of a section where the road is more slippery, because of snow, ice, bitumen spilled during road works, etc. (Road signs)
Are you allowed to park the car at the indicated place?
Allowed
Allowed if you live near this place
Prohibited
